title: A MESSAGE FROM #MATTHIAS THE #MARTYR
segments: as a follower of Christ I have seen
Miracles unfold before my eyes and heard
the powerful teachings of Jesus I was
humbled when I was chosen to be an
apostle replacing that devil Judas as
scariot through all the trials and
tribulations we have faced my faith
remains steadfast but now on this
fateful day my resolve is put to the
ultimate test the Roman authorities have
caught wind of our activ ities and have
deemed us a threat to their rule there
is an air of fear and anticipation among
us as we know that our persecution is
inevitable we gather together praying
for strength and guidance as we face
what lies ahead the day has come I am
LED here to a Public Square surrounded
by you an angry mob you hurl insults and
accusations at me your eyes filled with
contempt and rage I Stand Tall knowing
that I walk in the footsteps of my Lord
Jesus Christ I brace myself for what is
to come knowing this is the path of
martydom I refuse to falter for I am
filled with the holy spirit with every
stone that will Pelt my body I will
remember the stones thrown at stefen the
first Christian martyr I find comfort in
knowing that I am following in the
footsteps of those who have gone before
me who also gave their lives for the
gospel I'm reminded of the words of
Christ do not fear those who can kill
the body but cannot kill the soul in
this moment my faith takes on a new
meaning I focus on the Eternal rather
than the temporary finding strength in
the knowledge that I am doing God's will
my life as an apostle will be cut short
but my spirit will endure I have been
granted the privilege of joining the
ranks of the martyrs who have laid down
their lives for the sake of the Gospel I
have fought the good fight stood firm in
my faith Until the End My Sacrifice
Echoes Through the Ages inspiring
generations to come to stand firm in
their faith no matter the
cost
